Derrick Coleman is 59 years old.

Derrick Coleman was born in Mobile, Alabama.

Derrick Coleman was born on June 21, 1967.

How tall is Derrick Coleman?

Derrick Coleman is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Derrick Coleman weigh when playing?

Derrick Coleman weighed 230 lbs (104 kg) when playing.

Is Derrick Coleman in the Hall of Fame?

Derrick Coleman is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Derrick Coleman drafted?

Derrick Coleman was drafted by New Jersey Nets, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1990 NBA Draft.

What position did Derrick Coleman play?

Power Forward and Center.

When did Derrick Coleman retire?

Derrick Coleman last played in 2005.

What is Derrick Coleman's net worth?

Derrick Coleman made at least $91,366,800 playing professional basketball.

How much did Derrick Coleman make?

Derrick Coleman made $9,380,000 in 2003.

What did Derrick Coleman average?

Derrick Coleman averaged 16.5 points, 9.3 rebounds, and 2.5 assists per game.

How many rings does Derrick Coleman have?

Derrick Coleman won 0 championships.

What schools did Derrick Coleman attend?

Derrick Coleman attended Northern in Detroit, Michigan and Syracuse.

What are Derrick Coleman's nicknames?

D.C., Joe Jackson, Coast are nicknames for Derrick Coleman.
